create_ClassicTrainingParams: create a ClassicTrainingParams dataclass with seed, model, task, and optimizer settings for training
run_TrainingWorker: run a TrainingWorker to train a JAX model with length curriculum and logging
build_update_parameters: build a JIT-compiled SGD update step that computes gradients and applies optimizer updates
test_ClassicTrainingParams: test the ClassicTrainingParams dataclass with haiku model, loss function, and task configuration
summarize_TrainingWorker_run: summarize the TrainingWorker.run method that trains a model and optionally runs range evaluation
